meta.title: Contact
meta.description: A demo for your team, a question, a partnership: write to the team behind Godet, the maintenance log for construction machinery.

title: Let’s talk about your fleet
lead: A demo for your team, a question about Godet, a partnership: write to us. A member of our team will reply in person.

demo.text: We show you Godet with a fleet like yours and answer your questions.

studio: Godet is developed by <link>Swiss Digital Studio</link>, in Valais, Switzerland.
